evals.prompt: /orchestrate Research current pricing pages for 4 payment competitors (Stripe, Braintree, Adyen, Checkout.com), summarize each one's transaction fee structure, and write a single comparison table to competitor-pricing.md.
assertions: Decomposes the task into one research subtask per competitor (4 total), each explicitly classified as 'research'
Every subagent spawn call shown in the plan sets model explicitly to haiku for the research subtasks — none left unset or defaulted
The 4 competitor research tracks are grouped and run in parallel (spawned together), not sequentially one after another, since they touch no shared file
The final comparison table in competitor-pricing.md is synthesized/merged by the orchestrator itself, not delegated to a further subagent
No git commit is created without the orchestrator having reviewed the merged content first
